mapper.sql: id, problem_id, language, verdict, message, time_cost, score, status, user_id, create_time
mapper.insert: insert into submission(problem_id, code, language, verdict, message, time_cost, score, status, user_id, create_time) values (#{problemId}, #{code}, #{language}, #{verdict}, #{message}, #{timeCost}, #{score}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update submission set verdict = #{verdict}, message = #{message}, time_cost = #{timeCost}, score = #{score}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
update submission set status = #{status} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from submission where problem_id = #{problemId}
select * from submission where status = #{status} order by id
